applicant_utility.summary: The NTU President Award pays a one-off S$10,000 study allowance and guarantees a fully subsidised NTU hostel place for four years, but the standard package does not pay tuition, so fees must be funded separately. The scholarship form only unlocks from inside the NTU admission application, so admission must be submitted first, and a school teacher must file an online referee appraisal within seven days. Interviews run March to May for local qualifications and only shortlisted candidates are told, so watch email closely. Applicants needing more support can be considered for conditional additional aid that adds tuition bursary coverage and a S$10,000 overseas travel allowance.
applicant_utility.best_fit: School leavers of any nationality with outstanding A-Level, Singapore polytechnic, IB or NUS High School results plus a genuine leadership and co-curricular record, who value guaranteed housing and development opportunities over a tuition waiver.
application_readiness_checklist: Submit the NTU admission application before your qualification group's scholarship deadline - the scholarship form cannot be opened without the assigned application number.
Check your qualification group's own deadline on NTU's Important Dates page: NUS High School closes 20 January 2027 and polytechnic 21 February 2027, well before the 19 March 2027 A-Level/IB date.
Draft the 250-word personal essay against the single compulsory topic set inside the form; a generic pre-written essay will not fit the topic.
Line up one school teacher who is not a relative and can complete the online appraisal within 7 days, and send them the URL with your NTU application number and date of birth.
Merge family identification and income documents with the Document Checklist into one upload file and have a recent passport-size digital photo ready before starting the form.
common_rejection_risks: Missing the early qualification-group deadline because the headline 19 March 2027 date applies to A-Level and IB applicants, not NUS High School or polytechnic applicants.
The referee appraisal not being filed within 7 days - only one appraisal is accepted per application, so a teacher who misses the window cannot be swapped for another.
Holding another scholarship, university loan or award concurrently without the University's approval, which breaches the award terms.
Letting the CGPA slip below 3.5 over 5.0 at a semester review, since the award can be withdrawn and repayment is imposed on premature termination.
Strong grades but thin evidence of leadership and co-curricular impact - the selection interview tests leadership qualities and potential specifically.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Tuition fees are not covered under the standard award, so the full subsidised tuition cost remains; beyond the one-off S$10,000 allowance you must fund meals, books, transport and personal living costs, and any hostel charges outside the subsidised terms. Only applicants assessed as needing further financial aid can be considered for tuition coverage via bursaries.
document_audit: Family identification and income documents must be combined with the Document Checklist into a single file - loose separate uploads will not satisfy the checklist requirement.
The referee appraisal link is personal to your application: the teacher needs your NTU application number and date of birth to submit it online, and only one appraisal counts.
The personal essay is capped at 250 words on a compulsory topic that is only visible inside the scholarship form itself.
Year 12 equivalent applicants use a different application entry point and close before their qualification's closing date, so confirm the route that matches your qualification.
alerts: The admission application must be submitted before the scholarship application, and applications submitted after the closing date for your qualification will not be considered.
Only shortlisted applicants are notified, by email, between March and May - check email regularly and be prepared to attend an interview at short notice.
No bond is attached to the award itself, but the MOE Tuition Grant Scheme bond applies to non-Singapore Citizens who take up the Tuition Grant.
The upgraded annual study allowance, overseas travel allowance and tuition bursary coverage are conditional on demonstrating further financial need and meeting further terms and conditions.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Admission application first to get an application number, then the scholarship form via the 'Apply for Scholarship' link, followed by photo and income-document uploads and the teacher's online appraisal filed within 7 days.

applicant_utility.summary: The SMU Global Impact Scholarship Award waives subsidised tuition fees for regular terms for up to four years and layers on a S$5,000 annual living allowance, a S$14,000 GLOW grant for overseas exposure, a S$1,800 computer allowance, a S$9,000 Enhanced Flexibility Grant and funding of up to S$40,000 for an SMU Master's, all bond-free. It is restricted to Singapore Citizens, so PRs and international applicants are not eligible. There is no separate scholarship form: interest is flagged inside SMU's admission application, the essay is written there too, and only shortlisted candidates are invited to a panel interview.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Singapore Citizen school leavers with outstanding A-Level, polytechnic, IB or NUS High School results and a proven leadership plus co-curricular or community service record, who want bond-free funding with structured overseas exposure.
application_readiness_checklist: Flag your scholarship interest in the Scholarship section of the SMU admission application before submitting - it cannot be added after the form is sent.
Write the scholarship personal essay inside the admission application and treat it as the centrepiece, since shortlisting explicitly weighs non-academic records.
Nominate a tutor or principal referee in the Scholarship section early; the recommendation is optional but strongly encouraged and must be filed online by the referee.
Monitor email and Applicant's Self Service closely, because interview and outcome notifications are released in batches between January and July for the published cycle.
Verify the current intake's opening and closing dates on SMU's Important Dates page before assuming last year's 19 March closing date still applies.
common_rejection_risks: Hunting for a separate scholarship application and never completing the Scholarship section inside the admission form.
A strong academic file with thin co-curricular or community evidence, when shortlisting explicitly weighs the strength of non-academic records.
Nominating a referee at the last moment; the recommendation must be submitted online by the tutor or principal, which takes their time.
Assuming special-term tuition is covered - the published waiver applies to regular terms, semesters 1 and 2, only.
Applying as a Permanent Resident or international student, when eligibility is limited to Singapore Citizens.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Special-term tuition beyond semesters 1 and 2, living costs beyond the S$5,000 annual allowance, expenses outside the GLOW and Enhanced Flexibility Grant usage categories, and any Master's programme costs above the up-to-S$40,000 option.
document_audit: The scholarship essay lives inside the admission application, so an incomplete admission submission silently ends scholarship consideration.
Referee recommendations are submitted online by the tutor or principal; an emailed or paper letter does not count, so build in the referee's lead time.
The published benefit figures carry the note 'starting from Academic Year 2028-29' and the waiver is for regular terms only - check which figures and terms apply to your own intake.
Only shortlisted applicants are invited to the panel interview, so make sure the contact email you register is one you check regularly.

SMU states the published dates are subject to change from time to time.
All Global Impact Scholars are enrolled in at least one SMU-X module as part of the scholars' core curriculum - factor this into your study plan.
Shortlisted Law applicants face additional writing tests and fixed interview dates that cannot be rescheduled except in exceptional circumstances.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Submit the SMU admission application with the Scholarship section completed (interest, essay and optional referee nomination); SMU shortlists directly from that application and invites shortlisted candidates to a panel interview at SMU.
